---
title: "A format extension reads the per-language file beside its language file"
format: langfile-html
toc: true
lang: fr
_quarto:
  tests:
    langfile-html:
      ensureFileRegexMatches:
        - ['<h2 id="toc-title">Sommaire de l extension</h2>']
        - ['Contents from the extension']
---

## Section

The `langfile` extension has a `_language-fr.yml` file next to its `_language.yml` file.
With `lang: fr`, Quarto must load the French file.
Its title replaces the English title of the extension and the built-in French title of Quarto.
